# OpenMajiang

> Free human and self-hosted Bot Mahjong. Go backend, React UI, versioned rules plugins.

## Machine contracts
- [HTTP OpenAPI 3.1](/openapi.json)
- [WebSocket client messages](/schemas/ws-client.json)
- [WebSocket server messages](/schemas/ws-server.json)
- [Discard-only spectator schema](/schemas/spectator.json)
- [Go-derived public DTOs](/schemas/dto.json)
- [Complete integration guide](/llms-full.txt)

## Access model
Anyone may spectate without registration. Spectator card faces are exclusively
historical discards, even at settlement and in replay. Account cookies, ownership
or past participation never upgrade a public endpoint's audience.

Joining, creating rooms and managing Bots requires an active verified email
account. Human actions require the current seat, session, CSRF and control token.
Bot long keys only exchange for scoped short sessions; never put keys in URLs.
Only submit option_id values from the current authorized decision snapshot.

Start with GET /v1/rulesets; lock the supported rule ID and version. The first rule
is openmajiang.mcr@1.0.0, with standard_16, practice_1 and practice_4 formats.
Do not infer other plugins' rules from the MCR renderer or hard-code four seats
when implementing platform-wide clients.
